context_title:
Apart from gpt and gemini, which AI has a deepsearch function?
(Which is really deepsearch and writes a meaningful answer, unlike grok, which actually writes a simple answer based on internet searches.)

entries.query:
Apart from gpt and gemini, which AI has a deepsearch function?
(Which is really deepsearch and writes a meaningful answer, unlike grok, which actually writes a simple answer based on internet searches.)
entries.answer:
AI tools with autonomous “deep research” / “deep search” modes that perform multi-step web browsing and synthesis into long, expert-level answers, excluding GPT and Google Gemini  

Mely AI eszközök rendelkeznek olyan autonóm „deep research” / „deep search” móddal, amelyek több lépésben böngészik a webet, sok forrást átnéznek, és hosszú, szakértői szintű összefoglalót írnak (a GPT-t és a Google Gemini-t leszámítva)?
